description: 三重県道路台帳附図 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 三重県. 本ページでは、三重県が管理する道路台帳附図をShape形式及びDXF形式でダウンロードすることが可能です。 利用に際しては、以下の項目をご確認ください。 【留意事項】 ・道路台帳附図は、作成・更新時のものであり、道路台帳附図の更新時期等の関係で道路の形状等が現況と異なる場合があります。 ・データの利用に関して、利用者又は第三者に生じた損失... Coverage: 三重県. The portal files it under the publisher 三重県. Its tags are 建設工事, 道路台帳, 道路管理. It offers 21 resource(s) in .zip, zip. The portal shows 2026-03-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
